coordinate_convention.heading: outward; 0 degrees north, clockwise in plan view
coordinate_convention.slope: outward rise/run at the edge; percent = 100 * grade

piece.purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for DD RHW-4 — L1/L2 ↔ RHW-4 L0 — Mirrored Orthogonal Transition — 6 Tiles.
piece.name: DD RHW-4 — L1/L2 ↔ RHW-4 L0 — Mirrored Orthogonal Transition — 6 Tiles
piece.description: The mirrored six-tile coupled adapter has the stacked highway at its north-west end. Its lower deck travels south into the west ground carriageway, and its upper deck rises north from the east ground carriageway. Each direction retains two lanes and native DD and ground RHW-4 sockets.

engineering.cross_section_policy: Flat horizontal normal sections; true lane-speed curvature compensation
engineering.geometry_transform: East x becomes 16 minus x; height and north coordinates unchanged
engineering.directed_path_transform: Reflect each complete lane and reverse its directed point sequence; retain native lane classes
engineering.atlas_alpha_blend: One minus cubic smoothstep of deck height divided by 0.25 m
engineering.datum_transition: Native DD offset times remaining deck-height fraction; exact zero at ground
engineering.tile_clipping_policy: At most 1e-9 m input grid snap; exact half-space classification and bounded segment intersections
engineering.support_geometry_scope: Closed oriented rectangular piers and caps; structural capacity unverified
engineering.native_longitudinal_sample_station_m: 16 minus authored station s, before each deck's native UV orientation
engineering.native_uv_reflection_policy: Retain lateral U under geometry reflection; reverse native longitudinal sample phase for asphalt and barriers
engineering.support_coordinate_policy: Retain canonical source roles and lateral dimensions; reflect every complete solid by east x becoming 16 minus x
engineering.model_winding_policy: Reverse each reflected triangle's winding to preserve its outward face

provenance.geometry: Reviewed counterpart of the original six-tile adapter: reflect the complete road envelopes, supports, and lane geometry about east = 8 m, reverse directed travel, and align native DD pose 2 and native ground poses 0 and 2.
provenance.construction: Twelve row-major owners, three unowned native sockets, and four proper rotations repeated across eight cursor states. Native RUL1 solutions are reused without insertion or a RUL2 override.
provenance.granularity: One reusable coupled adapter. Its vertical profile depends on the lateral curve; arbitrary internal cuts do not supply standard interchangeable slope or curvature sockets.

connections.purpose: Intrinsic saved-resource endpoints, service roles, directed journeys, and forbidden transfers for one piece.

source.scope: one piece only; no counterpart catalogue is consulted
source.construction_basis: Actual emitted per-piece rule sections from the independently verified saved build
